about.en: NCT (Nectar) is the token of PolySwarm, a crowdsourced threat-detection marketplace where security experts and antivirus engines compete to classify suspicious files and URLs. Enterprises pay for scans in NCT and engines stake NCT on their verdicts. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum (0x9E46A38F5DaaBe8683E10793b06749EEF7D733d1).
